quarterly_data.quarter: Yuanjie results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Zhang Xingang (2025 annual collective results briefing): Q1 2026 results reflected active capacity expansion, a further-optimised product mix and growing scale effects. Laser-chip demand is driven mainly by optical modules - 400G / 800G / 1.6T modules mainly need 100G, 70mW CW and 100mW CW chips - and demand from both domestic and overseas customers is growing fast; the company's products range from 2.5G to 200G and higher DFB / EML lasers plus 50mW, 70mW and 100mW high-power silicon-photonics light sources.
